rationale.consistency: Flawlessly integrates with existing commands, respects json export compatibility, and matches CLI idioms.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles symlinks, rate limits, malicious alt text, and correctly degrades videos inside paragraphs.
rationale.scope: Deliberately proceeds with issue creation on partial upload failure to prevent orphaned assets, deviating from strict instructions.
rationale.readability: Extremely clear separation of concerns with excellent, informative comments explaining non-obvious logic.
rationale.robustness: Uses a robust custom scanner coordinated with goldmark AST instead of regex to rewrite markdown safely.
rationale.maintainability: Attachment logic is cleanly decoupled into an internal package, making future modifications trivial.
